reuse.why: Extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend and shares an isOffDay/isWeekendOrHoliday predicate, but the 'daily skips, others move' decision is not put behind one helper and is re-derived by each caller.

duplication.why: The per-occurrence skip-or-move block is written twice in schedules/app.ts (getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange) with different nesting, and the isDaily/skipWeekend decision is repeated again in getNextDate and budget/schedule-template.ts.

placement.why: Off-day and move logic sit in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-schedule rule is decided in server handlers and the budget template instead of the shared schedule module.

scope.why: Changes are on the requested features plus release notes; the getUpcomingDates rewrite into a manual scan loop is larger than needed but related.

maintainability.why: Four places each decide 'is daily -> skip, else move', with ad-hoc scan limits (count*7+14, MAX_WEEKEND_SCAN, margin by holiday count) and a misnamed findNonWeekend and aliased export, so the next weekend rule change must touch all of them.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts and createScheduleList in budget/schedule-template.ts decide daily-skip vs move themselves instead of using one shared occurrence-adjust function next to getNextDate/getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: The skip-or-move logic in getUpcomingDates (if skipWeekend && isDaily ... else push adjusted) and getDatesInRange (if skipWeekend { if isDaily ... else ... }) is the same decision reshaped; schedule-template's movesWeekend/adjust closure is a third reshaped copy.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gained holidays; getNextDate gained a daily-schedule special branch; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template createScheduleList each re-implement the daily check around the helper.
